title: Flat finite cone-block terms
statement: If every term of each E_k is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], every term of every finite cone block C_n [def-sc-compact-flat-telescope-blocks] is flat.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Flat finite cone-block terms.

proof.text: Each finite-sum term is a coproduct of flat terms. A cone term is isomorphic to a binary biproduct of the two relevant finite-sum terms. Express the biproduct as a coproduct over WalkingPair and use preservation of flatness under coproducts and isomorphisms.
